title: Are there any open-source that does not require coding to build strategies?
author: SnooBooks638
selftext:
I've been developing a trading infrastructure for about 5 years, to bridge the gap between financial intelligence and engineering intelligence. I'm curious to know if there any other open-source trading bots that allows users to construct their strategy in an excel formula style without knowing how to code or write python.

I'm also curious if this would be something an expert trader would like to try out.
